adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, ensure_embeddable runs as a before_filter and immediately raises Discourse::InvalidAccess if SiteSetting.embeddable_host.blank? (which is the default unless stubbed). In spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb, the example "is 404 without an embed_url" does not stub embeddable_host, so the request will fail due to the before_filter rather than params.require(:embed_url). The assertion `response.should_not be_success` also cannot distinguish the intended 404 from a 403/exception-driven failure, making the test potentially passing for the wrong reason.
